options.content: CI uses observed attempts from the latest 50 runs per repository. Historical trends start when Loki receives observations. Select the existing Kubernetes Loki datasource.

targets.expr: 100 * ((count by (service_id) (max_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, run_id, attempt, event_time, conclusion, check | kpi_kind="ci_completed_timestamp_seconds" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | repository=~"${repository:regex}" | squad=~"${squad:regex}" | conclusion=~"success" | event_time >= ${__from:date:seconds} | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [$__range]) by (service_id, run_id, attempt))) or on (service_id) (0 * count by (service_id) (max_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, run_id, attempt, event_time, conclusion, check | kpi_kind="ci_completed_timestamp_seconds" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | repository=~"${repository:regex}" | squad=~"${squad:regex}" | conclusion=~"success|failure|timed_out|startup_failure" | event_time >= ${__from:date:seconds} | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [$__range]) by (service_id, run_id, attempt)))) / (count by (service_id) (max_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, run_id, attempt, event_time, conclusion, check | kpi_kind="ci_completed_timestamp_seconds" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | repository=~"${repository:regex}" | squad=~"${squad:regex}" | conclusion=~"success|failure|timed_out|startup_failure" | event_time >= ${__from:date:seconds} | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [$__range]) by (service_id, run_id, attempt)))

panels.title: Daily average duration of recorded CI attempts
panels.description: Uses observation time in Loki. At initial collection, recent completed runs are recorded together.

targets.expr: avg by (service_id) (max_over_time({job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="monitoring",container="lantern-kpi-collector"} |= "LANTERN_KPI " | regexp `LANTERN_KPI (?P<payload>\{.*\})$` | line_format "{{.payload}}" | json kpi_kind="kind", kpi_value="value", service_id, repository, squad, run_id, attempt, event_time, conclusion, check | kpi_kind="ci_duration_seconds" | service_id=~"${service:regex}" | repository=~"${repository:regex}" | squad=~"${squad:regex}" | unwrap kpi_value | __error__="" [1d]) by (service_id, run_id, attempt))
